description: Lambda domain enforcement conformance vectors for mmrRank / mmr_select. The MMR score is a convex blend only when lambda in [0, 1]; out-of-range lambda triggers a precondition (Swift) / panic (Rust). Fixtures mirror the canonical A/B/C engram set (query = all-zero engram, distance = popcount).
notes: A: low 40 bits set (dist 40). B: low 44 bits set (dist 44). C: 80 bits in blocks 1..2 (dist 80).

valid_inputs.name: lambda_one_pure_relevance_accepted
valid_inputs.description: lambda = 1.0 (upper boundary) is accepted; pure relevance order

valid_inputs.name: lambda_interior_accepted
valid_inputs.description: lambda = 0.7 (interior) is accepted; diversity reorders to [A, C, B]
invariants: diversity pulls disjoint C ahead of near-duplicate B
